entries.message: The selected tab is now a sheet of translucent white, and a selected pin shows its site's color through the white. In Settings › Appearance › More Customization you can set how opaque the white is, turn off the pin's tint, or choose Material to bring back the earlier look in your material color.
Settings in dark mode are drawn in black and charcoal, like Crest's pop-up panels, instead of navy.
